description: OmniClaude Core Hooks - OMN-13244 measurement baseline with the OMN-13856, OMN-14330, OMN-15062, and OMN-15213 carve-outs. Every context-injection/measurement hook stays DISABLED; the only re-registered hooks are the Done-flip durable-evidence guard (OMN-13856, operator-approved, no fake Done), the OMN-7018 worktree canonical-root guard (OMN-14330, blocks `git worktree add` outside $OMNI_HOME/omni_worktrees), the SubagentStop secret-leak guard (OMN-15062, blocks a subagent's final report from completing when it matches a known secret pattern -- narrowly scoped security control), and the SubagentStop report-contract guard (OMN-15213, fails a lane RED when its final return is bare-Done-class instead of the report the golden-chain contract requires). Neither SubagentStop guard is a re-enable of the disabled context-injection/measurement hooks. All other scripts remain on disk and re-registration stays a pure config change.
